name: com.moqway/wholesale
title: Moqway
description: Wholesale catalog of verified factories worldwide for AI agents: products, MOQ, prices, ratings.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Who you are buying for: the buyer company, its default ship-to country, and the spending limits that decide whether place_order goes through on its own or waits for human approval. Call this first.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search published products from verified factories (each listing states where its factory is). Use short English keywords (e.g. 'stainless steel hook', 'silicone baking mat'). Filters are optional. Returns cards with the lowest tier price, MOQ, handling time and the supplier's Moqway rating; better-rated suppliers rank slightly higher. Prices and MOQ are per sale unit: pieces_per_unit is 1 for products sold by the piece, otherwise the pack size (then from_price_per_piece is given too). Call get_product for SKUs, full price tiers and carton data.

query.description: Keywords; omit to browse the newest listings

max_unit_price_usd.description: Only products whose lowest price per single piece is at or below this (products sold in packs are compared per piece)

ships_within_days.description: Max factory handling days before hand-over to the carrier

certification.description: e.g. CE, FCC, RoHS, CPC, LFGB

origin_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of origin (where the factory is), e.g. CN, VN, IN, MX

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full listing: SKUs with ids and live stock, quantity price tiers (USD per sale unit), MOQ, carton packing (units per carton, size, gross weight), country of origin and its export HS code (hs_code; for China also hs_code_cn, the 10-digit Chinese customs code), battery/liquid/magnet/powder flags, certifications and the supplier's Moqway rating. 'unit' and pieces_per_unit say what one unit is (a piece, or a pack such as 1,000 pcs); quote_order quantities count the same units. Use the sku_id values in quote_order.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Supplier verification and Moqway's rating over the last 365 days: an overall 0–100 score and ten dimensions (fulfilment against the factory's own promised ship time, order reliability, product quality, match to listing, packaging, after-sales, repeat buyers, verification, inquiry response measured by Moqway, and transparency: how much the factory has declared). Each dimension has its sample size, confidence and raw metrics, plus a plain-English summary, strengths and watch-outs. Suppliers with fewer than 3 paid orders are labelled 'new'. The breakdown needs a connected buyer account.

tools.name: list_shipping_options
tools.description: Shipping services and incoterms from a factory's country to a destination country (both ISO-2), with transit days and per-kg rates. Rates depend on where the goods ship from: pass from_country = the product's origin_country (default CN). DDP options include import duty.

from_country.description: Where the goods ship from: the product's origin_country

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Exact landed quote for one supplier's shipment: goods at tier price, freight by chargeable weight (cartons, volumetric), import-duty estimate, delivery days. Locks prices for 24 hours and returns quote_id for place_order. All SKUs must belong to one supplier.

destination_country.description: ISO-2 country code of the delivery address

incoterm.description: DAP: buyer pays import duty on arrival. DDP: duty included in freight.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places the order for a quote. If it is within the buyer's spending rules, payment is captured into escrow (released to the supplier only after delivery) and status is 'paid'. Otherwise status is 'pending_approval' and approval_url must be shown to the human; you cannot approve it. Calling again with the same quote_id returns the same order. Ship-to defaults to the buyer's saved address.

ship_to.description: Delivery address; omit to use the buyer's default

buyer_reference.description: Your PO or store order number, printed on documents

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Order status, timeline, deadlines, shipment tracking, dispute and the actions available now.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: The buyer's recent orders, newest first, optionally by status.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancels an order and refunds the escrowed payment in full: any paid order before the supplier accepts, or an accepted order once it is past its ship deadline (order.overdue is true). Before that, an accepted order cannot be cancelled.

tools.name: respond_to_ship_extension
tools.description: The supplier may ask once per order for up to 7 more days to ship (order.ship_extension with status 'open'). Approve to accept the new date, or reject to keep the original deadline; if the order then passes it, the buyer may cancel for a full refund. Ask the human unless their instructions already cover it. No answer within 48 hours counts as approval.

tools.name: confirm_receipt
tools.description: Confirms the shipment arrived. Starts a 7-day window for disputes, after which funds are released to the supplier. Only call this when the buyer confirms delivery. Afterwards, ask the buyer how the goods were and record it with rate_order.

tools.name: rate_order
tools.description: Records the buyer's rating of a shipped order, 1–5 stars: quality and as_described (goods match the photos and specs) are required, packaging and service optional. Only send ratings the buyer actually gave you; never guess them. Ratings feed Moqway's supplier rating and are not shown to the supplier. Calling again replaces the rating (allowed for 90 days after shipping).

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Opens a dispute on a shipped or delivered order; escrow is frozen until Moqway resolves it. Give a factual description and links to photos if any.

tools.name: get_order_documents
tools.description: Signed download links (valid 1 hour) for the commercial invoice and packing list, available after the supplier accepts. Needed for import customs clearance.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Send a question or request to one factory: customization (logo, colour, packaging), samples, quantities above stock or outside the price tiers, lead times, anything the listing does not settle. Give product_id (or supplier_id for a general question), a kind, the message in English and any structured details. The factory's AI assistant answers at once from the factory's own data; anything needing a person is forwarded and the factory replies in the same inquiry (poll get_inquiry). Do not share contact or payment details; Moqway handles payment.

needed_by.description: Date or period, e.g. 2027-02-15 or 'within 6 weeks'

customization.description: Logo, colour, size, material, packaging changes

tools.name: reply_to_inquiry
tools.description: Add a message to an open inquiry (a follow-up question, or an answer to the factory). The factory's assistant answers what it can and forwards the rest to the factory.

tools.name: get_inquiry
tools.description: The whole conversation of one inquiry with its status: your messages, the factory assistant's answers, and the factory's replies with any terms it stated (price, MOQ, lead time, sample cost).

tools.name: list_inquiries
tools.description: Your inquiries to factories, newest first. unread is true when the factory or its assistant wrote since you last read it.

tools.name: close_inquiry
tools.description: Close an inquiry you no longer need. The factory sees it as closed.
